messages.text: Just put your firmware on my bitaxe and love it.  You need to make firmware for the nano3S next.

Glad Harlo OS is treating you well on the Bitaxe, that's good to hear.

Nano 3S support isn't something I can promise. I'll pass the request to the team so it lands with the people who decide what gets built next.

Worth posting it in our Discord too, that's where JD (@nullhashrate) and the firmware crowd hang out: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Anything you're looking at buying while you're here?
